newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent mixed, support seen ahead of weekend.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent mixed, support seen ahead of weekend.

text.p: Brent crude futures were mixed on Friday in late trading on SIMEX with brokers expecting some book squaring to support the market ahead of the weekend.
However, they said the ample supply of physical crude would weigh on the market next week and asset the downside.
May Brent was last traded at $18.18 per barrel, level with London overnight. June was last traded at $18.39, down four cents.
A rebound was being encouraged by NYMEX crudes, which were firmer on ACCESS.
May was last traded at $19.57, near the intraday high of $19.58, and 10 cents higher than New York's close.

One broker said there seemed to be a wider sell off in financial market, which was worrying. He was referring to equities, rising interest rates in the U.S. and the 13.0-cent plunge overnight in May silver on COMEX.
